description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”, begins at approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreases to approximately 0.02 at layer 24. An orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”, begins at approximately 0.98 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.3 at layer 10, then fluctuates between approximately 0.3 and 0.45 until layer 24, ending at approximately 0.35. A green dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”, begins at approximately 0.97 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.25 at layer 10, and then remains relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately 0.2 and 0.3 until layer 24, ending at approximately 0.25.
